keyword: how fast is the artemis rocket
claims: The Artemis rocket (Space Launch System) reaches speeds of over 17,000 mph (approx. 27,350 km/h) to reach low-Earth orbit.
The Space Launch System accelerates to over 22,600 mph (36,370 km/h) for its journey to the Moon.
The Orion capsule hits 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h) upon reentry.
The Space Launch System reaches over 1,000 mph within the first minute of liftoff.
The RS-25 engines accelerate the Space Launch System to roughly 17,000-17,500 mph within 8 minutes.
The upper stage (ICPS) boosts the velocity to over 22,000 mph to escape Earth's orbit.
Upon returning from the Moon, the Orion capsule hits Earth's atmosphere at approximately 25,000 mph.
The Orion capsule endures temperatures of 5,000°F.
The Space Launch System carries the Orion crew capsule to deep space.
The Space Launch System burns over six tons of propellant every second during launch
